principle: A quiet main canvas gives data priority.
guidance: One continuous page surface; remove dashboard-card grids.

principle: Secondary surfaces are only slightly different.
guidance: Low-contrast navigation and table headers.

principle: Navy/neutral text carries most of the interface.
guidance: Colour does not decorate every section.

principle: Strong colour identifies interaction.
guidance: One recognisable primary action colour.

principle: Status colours are separate from action colours.
guidance: Labelled status icons, with independent primary buttons.

principle: A small type scale establishes hierarchy.
guidance: 24px page title, 16px section title, 14px body, 12px metadata.

principle: Inter is the main interface face.
guidance: Shared sans-serif type; remove oversized editorial greetings.

principle: Regular and semibold weights do the work.
guidance: Avoid heavy headings on every row.

principle: Spacing follows a repeatable scale.
guidance: Shared 4/8/12/16/24/32px roles.

principle: Controls have modest corner radii.
guidance: 4px controls; no repeated rounded containers.

principle: Main destinations occupy a compact top bar.
guidance: Visible icon-and-label navigation in both portals.

principle: The active destination has a restrained underline.
guidance: Current section stays obvious without a large filled tile.

principle: The current collection/scope sits beside its heading.
guidance: Event context directly above the teams or task list.

principle: A dropdown changes scope in place.
guidance: Event picker clears stale selection and pagination.

principle: Account tools are separated from main work.
guidance: Compact profile menu with account and sign-out actions.

principle: Local section navigation stays local.
guidance: Overview/access/activity tabs belong inside a team detail.

principle: Returning to a collection is explicit.
guidance: Named back link preserves the collection filter.

principle: Global navigation supports keyboard search.
guidance: Command search routes to relevant screens.

principle: Commands use verb-first, sentence-case labels.
guidance: “Review access”, “Save draft”, “Confirm submission”.

principle: Entity actions stay with the selected entity.
guidance: Team changes appear on rows/details, not global search.

principle: One shared icon component keeps shapes consistent.
guidance: Use the same Lucide stroke set throughout.

principle: Action icons use a restrained size.
guidance: 16px navigation, search, export and row-action icons.

principle: Icon colour follows the action's text.
guidance: CurrentColor icons remain readable in every variant.

principle: Icons identify the kind of action.
guidance: Search, filter, export, columns, external reference and overflow are distinct.

principle: Important actions include text labels.
guidance: No icon-only primary actions.

principle: Icon-only controls need an accessible name.
guidance: Label close, more, command and clear controls.

principle: The page's main action is easy to locate.
guidance: Primary action sits beside the title, not inside an arbitrary card.

principle: Secondary actions have less visual weight.
guidance: Export/columns are quiet text-and-icon controls.

principle: Hover, press and focus are distinct.
guidance: Shared interaction variants, visible keyboard focus.

principle: A loading action retains its dimensions and variant.
guidance: Spinner and loading text replace content without a layout jump.

principle: A table is the collection's main content.
guidance: Teams and people are rows, not a grid of cards.

principle: Headers use a subtle contrasting surface.
guidance: Quiet header band and fine separators.

principle: Rows align comparable information into columns.
guidance: Team, members, repository and access state share baselines.

principle: Entity names act as the detail entry point.
guidance: Named team links open the selected detail journey.

principle: Supporting metadata sits below the main identifier.
guidance: Small published/draft context under team names.

principle: Sort affordances live in the column heading.
guidance: Click name/member headers to change actual row order.

principle: The sort direction remains visible.
guidance: Directional arrow and aria-sort reflect the active order.

principle: Row selection has its own column.
guidance: Labelled native checkboxes, separate from entity links.

principle: Selection changes the available actions.
guidance: Selected-count toolbar exposes a scoped review action.

principle: Clearing selection is explicit.
guidance: A visible “Clear selection” action restores the normal toolbar.

principle: A result count anchors the toolbar.
guidance: Count updates with filters and search.

principle: Search belongs next to the collection.
guidance: Search team/person names without leaving the page.

principle: Search has an identifiable magnifier.
guidance: Visible icon and a programmatic input label.

principle: Status filtering is a compact dropdown.
guidance: All / needs attention / ready / unused states.

principle: Filters and search can combine.
guidance: Apply both predicates and show the resulting count.

principle: Columns can be adjusted.
guidance: A column menu changes optional visible columns.

principle: Export is available from the collection toolbar.
guidance: Preview the exact safe filtered CSV fields; production download uses authorised data.

principle: Pagination has named previous/next actions.
guidance: Real page slices with boundary-disabled controls.

principle: Filter changes reset an obsolete page.
guidance: Return to the first page after narrowing results.

principle: Single-page collections omit unnecessary paging.
guidance: Hide pagination when all matching records fit.

principle: Fields have concise labels.
guidance: Keep labels visible in draft and review forms.

principle: Help text is separate from error text.
guidance: URL guidance remains distinct from validation feedback.

principle: Pristine fields do not start in an error state.
guidance: No red warnings on first opening the form.

principle: Edited fields validate at a sensible boundary.
guidance: Validate a touched field on blur.

principle: Submit validates the whole form.
guidance: Surface all required evidence errors together.

principle: An invalid submit does not call the operation.
guidance: Keep the form open and focus the first invalid input.

principle: An editable invalid form still allows a submit attempt.
guidance: Let the action reveal how to fix it rather than silently disabling it.

principle: One actionable error appears per field.
guidance: “Enter a valid demo URL”; no stacked generic warnings.

principle: Optional empty fields are valid.
guidance: An optional note does not block the next step.

principle: Irrelevant dependent errors clear.
guidance: Clear stale format errors when a field is removed or no longer required.

principle: Whitespace is handled consistently.
guidance: Trim URL and label inputs before validation/review.

principle: Input length follows the contract.
guidance: Bound evidence labels and URLs; do not introduce unbounded fields.

principle: A native form owns submission.
guidance: Enter, the local form event and the review action share one validation boundary in the preview.

principle: In-flight actions prevent duplicate submission.
guidance: Both button state and an intent guard prevent double clicks.

principle: Fields freeze while a request is in flight.
guidance: Submitted values cannot change behind a pending confirmation.

principle: Failures restore editing.
guidance: Restore fields and retain the same draft after a known failure.

principle: Field errors and transport errors differ.
guidance: Inline validation versus a clear save failure message.

principle: Cancelling a focused form is available.
guidance: Cancel returns to the source context with the draft intact.

principle: Successful work gives visible confirmation.
guidance: Completion message, updated row, and next relevant action.

principle: Sensitive values stay out of ordinary display.
guidance: Never render installation tokens or App private keys.

principle: A modal has one clear task title.
guidance: “Review repository recovery” or “Confirm submission”.

principle: Close has a predictable position.
guidance: Labelled close control at the top right.

principle: Escape exits a dismissible task.
guidance: Keyboard escape and focus return work.

principle: The background remains recognisable.
guidance: Keep source-list context behind a focused decision.

principle: Task width matches its content.
guidance: Narrow confirmation, wider form, no full-screen tiny dialog.

principle: Local options sit inside the current task.
guidance: Choose an operation before reviewing its consequences.

principle: Main and cancellation actions have clear hierarchy.
guidance: Quiet Back/Cancel and one specific confirmation action.

principle: Modal contents are separated from the action footer.
guidance: Stable footer with the next step and current step count.

principle: The task remains bound to the selected entity.
guidance: Team name stays in list, detail, review and confirmation.

principle: Task completion preserves the working context.
guidance: Return to the source list/detail; its record updates and filters remain intact.

principle: Status includes a text label.
guidance: “Needs review” remains understandable without colour.

principle: Status and warning icons reinforce meaning.
guidance: Check, clock and warning icons distinguish conditions.

principle: An empty collection has a purposeful next action.
guidance: Draft event explains publication and offers “Review allocation”.

principle: No matches is different from no records.
guidance: A clear-filters path restores an existing collection.

principle: Collection headings survive state changes.
guidance: Keep scope and toolbar visible during load/no-match states.

principle: Loading indicates an operation is underway.
guidance: Spinner and action text are announced; no fake success.

principle: Disabled actions have contextual explanations.
guidance: Explain frozen allocation or a not-yet-open submission window beside the control.

principle: Feedback appears near the completed work.
guidance: Toast/status message plus updated row or accepted revision.

principle: Explanatory tooltips supplement visible text.
guidance: Icon hints are optional; essential instructions stay visible.

principle: Details reveal evidence progressively.
guidance: Activity and recovery evidence appear after selecting a team.

principle: Shared colour roles have a single owner.
guidance: CSS-first Tailwind v4 semantic tokens feed every proposal.

principle: Dark mode changes roles, not arbitrary components.
guidance: Paired light/dark tokens keep the same hierarchy.

principle: A reusable button variant system keeps actions consistent.
guidance: Shared primary, secondary, ghost, destructive and link roles.

principle: API-derived permission gates match the destination.
guidance: Prototype phase capabilities model, rather than bypass, backend gates.

principle: Navigation keeps current scope in mind.
guidance: Account/event changes clear stale selected entities.

principle: Query/search and local editing have different lifecycles.
guidance: Search does not overwrite an in-progress submission draft.

principle: User-supplied strings are treated as data.
guidance: Escape labels and notes before inserting them into the prototype.

principle: Wide data is contained, not allowed to break the page.
guidance: Reflow rows on phones and constrain table overflow where needed.

principle: Keyboard handling respects native controls.
guidance: Native buttons, fields and form submit; scoped command shortcut.

principle: Tests focus on visible outcomes.
guidance: Verify complete journeys, validation, retained context and changed rows.
